name: Colier
title: Colier
summary: Colier was Baron Colier's Aluvian mining town, now a ghost town overrun by banderlings and drudges with undead miners. The kit shows the ring of Aluvian stone houses, huts and cottages around the looping road (z 118-120, x 33590-33740) under a canopy of giant trees (38-46 m crowns, tops z 155), a well and garbage barrels; west along the road a burnt grove of black dead trees and stumps, the grave-warning Monolith and the Destroyed Portal to Holtburg; the Life Stone stands on the hill north-east (z 171). Landblocks west of x 33408 (0xADxx) are missing from the kit.
